content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the application fee or the full selection process.

rows.details: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC), New Delhi, on behalf of Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (MoHFW)

content_sections.heading: About NHSRC
content_sections.text: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is based in New Delhi. Under these Terms of Reference, it is recruiting on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare for the Central TB Division. The post deals with Public-Private Partnerships for TB control in India under the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following essential qualification and requirements for the Technical Officer (Public Private Partnership) post: M.A. in Sociology/ Master of Social Work (MSW)/ PGD in Social Work (PGDSW)/ PGD in Rural Development/ M.A. in Rural Development/ MBA in Rural Development/ M.A. in Social Science or PGD in Social Science, OR MBA. Working knowledge of computers. The notice lists these as preferential qualifications and skills. They are not part of the essential qualification. Experience of working in the field of public health programs at National/ State level, preferably in Public Private Partnerships and/ or the health system. At least five (05) years of experience in case of Post Graduate Diploma qualification, and three (03) years of experience in case of Post Graduate Degree qualification. At least 3 years' experience in project management is desirable. The age limit is "Upto 65 years". The notice does not print an age cut-off date or any age relaxation. Along with the age requirement, the notice says that candidates must be ready to travel extensively. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following responsibilities for the Technical Officer (Public Private Partnership): To handle day to day correspondence at Central TB Division pertaining to Public-Private-Partnerships for TB control in India. To assist the CTD in maintaining database of stake holders in PPP (including mapping and regular updating). Coordination with different Core Committees and Technical Working Group for PPM. To assist in updating and revising PPP guidelines according to the policy revisions. To facilitate the national/regional trainings on PPP. Implement, review and evaluate NTEP partnership with medical colleges including facilitation of NTF, ZTF, STF and Core Committees of Medical Colleges involved in NTEP. Plan, coordinate and facilitate involvement of corporate hospitals and DNB institutions in NTEP. Coordinate and facilitate involvement of other public health sectors and institutions like CGHS, ESI, Railways etc. Coordinate with MCI, NCI, PCI and AYUSH councils for incorporation of NTEP in curricula. To conduct supervisory visits to states/districts to monitor PPP implementation and report to CTD. To assist in monitoring the enrolment of health facilities, Private Practitioners and NGOs under various PPP schemes, their performance and disbursal of Grand in Aids. To assist in monitoring the PPP performance of the States/UTs and districts based on relevant indicators derived from respective quarterly reports and PPP reports, and providing feedbacks to states/districts. To assist in compiling PPP reports to the Government of India and PPP stakeholders. To assist in conducting meetings with partners, documenting the minutes, compiling reports on action taken and providing feedbacks. To work in collaboration with technical officers of other thematic areas of the program on cross cutting issues. To identify and foster innovative and sustainable financing mechanism for effective programme implementation and assist in stake holder consultation. To assist Central TB Division in organizing periodic review meeting of State PPM Coordinators at national level, and to facilitate change management with respect to use of ICT and Nikshay tools for concerned data entry, validation and its use for public health action. Any other job assigned as per programme need.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHSRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must fill the online application available on the NHSRC website ( http://nhsrcindia.org ) correctly. Applications are accepted in the prescribed online application format only, and the last date for receiving applications is 30 November 2026. The notice does not list any documents to attach and does not mention an application fee.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice does not describe the stages of selection. It sets one condition: if the recruitment process includes a written test, the minimum qualifying mark will be 70%.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NHSRC Technical Officer (Public Private Partnership) post?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for the NHSRC Technical Officer (Public Private Partnership) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.A. in Sociology, MSW, PGDSW, PGD or M.A. or MBA in Rural Development, or an M.A. or PGD in Social Science, or alternatively an MBA. They also need working knowledge of computers.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the NHSRC Technical Officer post?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 65 years. The notice also requires candidates to be ready to travel extensively.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the NHSRC Technical Officer (Public Private Partnership)?
faq.answer: The remuneration range is between Rs. 90,000/- and Rs. 1,30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the online application on the NHSRC website (http://nhsrcindia.org) by 30 November 2026. Applications are accepted only in the prescribed online application format.

faq.question: Q6. What are the qualifying marks if there is a written test?
faq.answer: If the recruitment process includes a written test, the minimum qualifying mark will be 70%.

faq.question: Q7. Is the NHSRC Technical Officer post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the post is offered purely on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. How much experience is preferred for the NHSRC Technical Officer post?
faq.answer: The notice prefers at least five years of experience for Post Graduate Diploma holders and three years for Post Graduate Degree holders. Experience in public health programs at National/State level, preferably in Public Private Partnerships and/or the health system, is also preferred, and at least 3 years' experience in project management is desirable.
